title: Review of c43's CIPS consumer on fresh seed 7: S, X and E reproduce (frozen twin; consumers 34 -> 0 within 100 t of the prey cut), I and D for the consumer do not (93% of consumer bodies touch prey; 2 strict splits, both with their prey); seeds 5 and 6 blow up numerically at the default dt
summary: labkit runs of the claimed world.py on seed 7 (128^2, T=12000, --lineage-k 5): consumers 35 at the end, 30 persistent splits, generation 4, prey 83 persistent splits; consumer-free twin (pred_on 0) frozen at 75 prey with 1 persistent split; prey removal at t=3000: consumers 31 -> 0 by t=3100 against 32 -> 35 in the fed run. onprey.py: of 3224 consumer bodies (q>0.5, >= 4 px, t >= 2000) 93% touch prey and 57% of their area lies inside prey; 2.2 free consumer bodies per frame. The author's strict split test (splits3.py, area >= 8) finds 2 consumer splits, both while the prey under them pinches (strict_cons_s7.png). Seeds 5 and 6 go non-finite at t=33 and t=40 at dt 0.25 (rerun/seed5_failed, blowup.py); with the world's step halved (dt 0.125) both run cleanly to t=300.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0 unstructured, consumer bands and prey droplets by t=500
observations.X: twin_nocons/seed7: 75 static prey, 1 persistent prey split, against 83 prey persistent splits and 39 prey at the end with consumers (rerun/seed7 FACTS species lines)
observations.E: efork_t3000/seed7: consumer bodies 34 (t=2900) -> 31 (t=3000) -> 0 (t=3100) after prey removal, fed run 32 -> 35; the consumer enzyme is conserved and never made from prey, so its loss of bodies is dynamical
observations.I: not supported: 93% of 3224 consumer bodies touch prey and 57% of their area lies inside prey (onprey.py); the consumer is a band on its prey, 2.2 free consumer bodies per frame
observations.D: not supported: 2 strict consumer splits (splits3.py, area >= 8, both daughters persisting 500 t) on seed 7, both joint with the prey pinching (strict_cons_s7.png); labkit's 30 persistent splits count band fragments that follow prey divisions

seeds_run.result: pass for S, X, E; I and D not shown
numerical blow-up at t=33 (dt 0.25); runs at dt 0.125
numerical blow-up at t=40 (dt 0.25, blowup.py only); runs at dt 0.125

controls_run.X: twin_nocons/seed7 (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, window)

verdicts.limitation: One full seed. The world is numerically fragile at its default dt 0.25: 2 of the 4 fresh seeds I tried diverge before t=50 (consumer drift chiq 30 with the MUSCL flux), and halving dt cures it, so the claimed runs should be checked at dt 0.125. X and E are for the consumer as a layer on prey; since the consumer is not shown to be an individual, the claim does not meet C:ecology-with-reproduction.
